description: TypeScript type definitions for the BalancedPool class, which extends Dispatcher and manages upstream connections for load balancing in a networking context.

classes.name: BalancedPool
classes.description: A class extending Dispatcher that manages multiple upstream URLs for load balancing purposes, with methods to add or remove upstreams and manage connection state.

methods.name: constructor (url: string | string[] | URL | URL[], options?: Pool.Options) constructor
methods.description: Creates a new BalancedPool instance with specified URL(s) and options.

methods.name: addUpstream
methods.description: Adds a new upstream URL to the pool.

methods.name: removeUpstream
methods.description: Removes an existing upstream URL from the pool.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection using the pool, either returning a promise or invoking a callback.

ctags.name: constructor
ctags.pattern: /^  constructor (url: string | string[] | URL | URL[], options?: Pool.Options)$/
